description: This Java class, RecurringDepositProductSheetPopulator, is responsible for generating an Excel sheet populated with data about recurring deposit products. It interfaces with Apache POI to create and format the spreadsheet, including setting headers, column widths, and filling in rows with product data.

classes.name: RecurringDepositProductSheetPopulator
classes.description: A class that populates an Excel sheet with recurring deposit product data, creating headers and formatting columns accordingly, using Apache POI library.

methods.name: RecurringDepositProductSheetPopulator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the populator with a list of recurring deposit product data objects.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Creates an Excel sheet and populates it with product data, applying styles and formatting.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Sets up header row and column widths for the sheet.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Returns the list of product data objects.
